file_discovery.purpose: Find files, source locations and existing artifacts; read only.

bounded_read.purpose: Read specified files and extract cited facts; no research verdict.

mechanical_checks.purpose: Run specified checks and report complete output; no interpretation or scientific promotion.

structured_extraction.purpose: Build bounded inventories/tables from specified files with provenance and omissions.

artifact_indexing.purpose: Prepare file/count/hash evidence using specified scripts; no old-file mutation.

bounded_implementation.purpose: Implement a specified interface in exclusively owned files.

implementation_review.purpose: Independently check bounded implementation and tests; escalate subtle issues explicitly.

simulator_forensics.purpose: Reconcile transition/observation rules and influenceable bottlenecks.

algorithm_design.purpose: Develop candidate objectives, controls and falsifiers.

predictive_research.purpose: Audit likelihoods, selection, dependence, leakage and model evaluation.

statistical_design.purpose: Register inference, power, multiplicity and selection/confirmation rules.

independent_statistics.purpose: Reconstruct scientific results without implementer analysis imports.

adversarial_review.purpose: Challenge apparent gains, causal explanations, leakage and confounding.

mathematical_proof.purpose: Prove/refute difficult structural claims and certify reductions/bounds.

dynamic_planning.purpose: Analyze nonseparable continuation, belief-state planning and exact-model reductions.

documentation.authority_for_model_slugs_and_fork_rules: Actual collaboration tool schema in this environment; not inferred from generic API defaults.
